seo.title: ChatSched — Ukukhangisa Okuphethwe, Imakethe & Inethiwekhi Yabashicileli
seo.description: Tshela i-ChatSched inhloso yakho, umphathi wemikhankaso akwakhele yona — noma ubheke futhi ubhuke abashicileli nabadidiyeli baseNingizimu Afrika ngokwakho — ezokuxhumana komphakathi, umdidiyeli, iwebhusayithi, i-podcast nomsakazo.

hero.subtitle: Sitshele inhloso nesabelomali sakho — sizokwakhela umkhankaso. Noma uphequlule amakhasi, ama-podcast nezikhala zomsakazo zangempela ngokwakho. Noma iyiphi indlela, konke kulandelwa kusukela esicelweni kuya ebufakazini.
hero.secure: Inkokhelo igcinwa ngokuphepha kuze kuqinisekiswe ukuboniswa

heroMockup.footer: Khetha ukuboniswa. I-ChatSched igcina isicelo, inkokhelo nobufakazi ndawonye.

twoWays.title: I-platform eyodwa. Khetha usizo olungakanani oludingayo.
twoWays.subtitle: Vumela i-ChatSched iphathe umkhankaso, noma ukhethe ngokwakho izikhala zokukhangisa emakethe.
twoWays.agencyBody: Sitshele inhloso, izilaleli nesabelomali. I-ChatSched iyakha uhlelo futhi iphathe inqubo yokubhuka.
twoWays.marketplaceBody: Sesha izikhala zangempela, qhathanisa futhi uthumele isicelo nge-ChatSched.

comparison.title: Ayikho i-algorithm. Ayikho i-akhawunti yezikhangiso. Ayikho impi yokubhida.
comparison.subtitle: Ama-platform endabuko akuthengisa ukufinyelela endalini. I-ChatSched ikuvumela ukhethe izikhala zangempela futhi igcine inqubo endaweni eyodwa.
comparison.closer: Khetha lapho umyalezo wakho uvela khona — bese ugcina ubufakazi.

marketplace.title: Izikhala zokukhangisa sezilindile.
marketplace.subtitle: Bheka abashicileli nezikhala zangempela, ubone izilaleli, bese uthumela isicelo nge-ChatSched.
marketplace.emptyDescription: Izikhala zabashicileli eziqinisekisiwe zizovela njengoba zivulwa.

channels.title: Izilaleli esisodwa. Izindlela eziningi zokufinyelela kuzo.
channels.subtitle: Amakhasi omphakathi, abadali, amawebhusayithi, ama-podcast, umsakazo namanye amathuba endawo — njengoba ukunikezwa kuqinisekiswa.

local.title: Amakhasimende akho akuwona “uMzantsi Afrika”. Asebhizinisini noma endaweni ethile.
local.subtitle: Sebenzisa indawo ukuze uthole amathuba okukhangisa lapho amakhasimende akho ehlala, esebenza futhi echitha isikhathi.

township.title: Ama-Spaza Shops & Township Traders
township.body: Finyelela izilaleli zomphakathi ngabashicileli bendawo namathuba okukhangisa.

transport.title: I-Minibus Taxi & Transport Media
transport.body: Beka umyalezo wakho lapho abagibeli bendawo sebevele benaka khona.

associations.title: Local Associations & Business Networks
associations.body: Finyelela imiphakathi ethile ngezinhlangano nabashicileli abathenjwayo.

suburbs.title: Kuze kufike endaweni yakini
suburbs.body: Yakha umkhankaso wasendaweni ogxile ezindaweni nezilaleli ezithile.

how.title: Kusukela kumlayezo wokuqala kuya ebufakazini bemiphumela — nakhu okwenzekayo.

1.title: Sitshele inhloso yakho
1.body: Khetha indlela ephethwe noma uqale ukubheka.

trust.title: Imali yakho. Umkhankaso wakho. Ubufakazi bakho.
trust.subtitle: I-ChatSched yakhelwe ukugcina zombili izinhlangothi kunqubo eyodwa ecacile.

payment.title: Inkokhelo ephephile
payment.body: Inkokhelo yakho igcinwa ngokuphepha yi-ChatSched — ayikhokhelwa umshicileli — kuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuboniswa sekusebenzile.

verified.title: Ababambiqhaza abaqinisekisiwe
verified.body: Amabhizinisi nabashicileli basebenzisa ukuqinisekiswa nokulawulwa kokuthembana kwe-ChatSched ngaphambi kokuba umkhankaso uqhubeke.

tracked.title: Inqubo eyodwa elandelwayo
tracked.body: Izicelo, ukuvunywa, isimo senkokhelo nobufakazi kuhlala kuxhunyiwe endaweni eyodwa.

tools.title: Akuyona imakethe kuphela. Amathuluzi okukusiza ukukhangisa.
tools.subtitle: Thola ukukhangisa, hlela imikhankaso futhi usebenzise amathuluzi akhelwe ukukhula kwebhizinisi lendawo.

pricing.title: Qala ngaphandle kokunye okubhaliselwe nyanga zonke.
pricing.subtitle: Ukuvulwa kwebhizinisi nomshicileli kukhokhwa kanye. Akukho ukuvuselelwa. Izimali zokubhuka ziboniswa ngaphambi kokuzibophezela.
pricing.businessBody: Finyelela ukwakha imikhankaso, ukukhangisa okuphethwe nemakethe.
pricing.publisherBody: Vula iphrofayela yakho nezici zenethiwekhi yabashicileli.
pricing.commission: Amabhukingi aqediwe asebenzisa ikhomishini ye-platform engu-{{commission}}% esobala; {{share}}% iya kumshicileli.

publisherCta.title: Usuyakhile izilaleli. Manje zivumele zikusebenzele.
publisherCta.subtitle: Guqula ikhasi lakho, iwebhusayithi, i-podcast, umsakazo noma elinye ithuba lokukhangisa libe yimali.

final.title: Usukulungele ukufinyelela amakhasimende akho?
final.subtitle: Sitshele ofuna ukukufeza, noma thola indawo yakho yokukhangisa.
final.closer: Ayikho i-akhawunti yezikhangiso. Ayikho impi yokubhida. Inqubo eyodwa elandelwayo.
